messages.mission.catalog-specialists.title: Salvage and Build
messages.mission.catalog-specialists.briefing.sho: Use tools, material and drone bays to support your force.
messages.mission.catalog-specialists.budget: An engineering action replaces movement and fire. Each action shows its cost and your supply.
messages.v2.specialists.damageNote: D and NE have no effect on modules. X destroys exactly the selected module.
messages.v2.specialists.helplessNote: A platform is destroyed when it has no treads and no usable weapons or tools left. Cargo alone does not keep it alive.
messages.v2.specialists.shotResolving: Wait until the current shot has fully resolved.
messages.v2.engineer.budgetNote: Engineering action at range {range}, replacing movement and fire.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.componentRequired: Choose a specific component of the platform.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.componentUnavailab: This component is no longer available as a target.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.engineerUnavailabl: Engineering requires an active, unembarked friendly unit in the Movement Phase. It must not have moved, disembarked or acted this turn.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.toolRequired: No intact, ready tool is available.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.occupied: Terrain work requires an unoccupied hex. The acting unit must not be on it either.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.clearTerrain: Only rubble fields, craters or forest can be cleared.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.positionTerrain: A field position requires open ground or a road.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.bridgeTerrain: A bridge requires a single river hex with passable land banks on opposite sides.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.repairTarget: Choose an adjacent, living, unembarked friendly unit. Self-repair is unavailable.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.vehicleRepair: This repair is available only for vehicles and drones, not infantry strength or buildings.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.noRepairEffect: There is no applicable damage to repair.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.nonrepairable: Only destroyed, non-expendable modules can be repaired. Ammunition and cargo are not restored.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.treadsFull: The treads are already fully repaired.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.salvage: Salvage requires an adjacent, unsalvaged wreck and room in the material supply.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.bayUnavailable: The selected drone bay is destroyed or not ready yet.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.forgeCargo: Choose an active friendly drone and carrier with a ready bay and unused main movement.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.forgeLoad: Loading requires an empty bay and an adjacent drone with unused movement and fire. It cannot board again after deployment in the same turn.
messages.v2.specialists.reject.forgeDeploy: Choose an empty adjacent land hex. The drone must be in the selected bay and must not have boarded this turn.
